title.fr: Radioactivité et types de rayonnements (α, β, γ)

sketch:
Observe: SVG parent-nucleus population grid + polyline daughter
counts right, one colored trace per rayonnement type (α, β⁻, β⁺,
γ). Student picks parent isotope; each nucleus emits its
characteristic rayonnement with lifetime drawn from its own seeded
fork. HUD writes the transformation equation (e.g., ²³⁸U → ²³⁴Th
+ α). Experiment: 3 seeded (parent → daughter + rayon) quiz
triples; student picks the rayonnement type from a 4-option chooser.
Evaluate: symbols hidden; student writes ᴬ_ZX and daughter given
only the arrow. Wrinkle: conservation of A and Z in HUD.
